'''Volan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Republic Army]] aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], selling combat gear during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Volan first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvP Gear Vendor. Volan's appearance and gear was changed with the release of Game Update 2.0, when the elder game gear system was overhauled. She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
